mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "authors" lists or searches researchers. "author" fetches a full researcher profile with per-source publication metrics. "affiliations" lists institutions with their aggregate scores.

query.title: Search query
query.description: "authors" mode: free-text search over researcher names. Leave blank to walk the full national index (335,000+ researchers, ranked by SINTA score).

enrichProfiles.title: Also fetch full profiles
enrichProfiles.description: "authors" mode: after listing, fetch each researcher's own profile too -- adds affiliation scores and the full Scopus / Google Scholar / Web of Science publication table. Costs one extra request per researcher.

sintaId.title: SINTA ID or profile URL
sintaId.description: "author" mode: a numeric SINTA ID, or a full profile address.

sintaIds.title: SINTA IDs
sintaIds.description: "author" mode: several researchers to fetch in one run.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: "authors" / "affiliations" mode: how many records to collect. Listing pages hold 10 each and are followed automatically. The index held 335,591 researchers and 5,567 affiliations at build time.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many profiles to fetch in parallel ("author" mode, and "authors" mode when full profiles are enabled).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default for stable results on long paginated runs against a government host.
